path: 競馬予想_完全版プロンプト_v3.11.txt
rule: Read latest_prompt.json then verify e2e_validation/manifests/v3.11.json append-only SHA pins. Keep STEP1, past race reports, historical bets and v3.7 approved PDF CSS immutable. For new prereace races, run v3.11 bounded-risk B-choice purchase overlay: compare exact max-EV baseline with multi-ticket sets constrained by positive expected net profit, >=90% baseline EV with max 200-yen sacrifice, and <=2pp net-loss increase; use joint finish outcomes for union hit rate; require >=1pp union-hit gain or keep baseline. Generate selected/rejected/risk-audit as three meaningful tail chapters with unlimited dynamic pagination, no dummy pages, print every adopted/rejected ticket, rerender as needed. Seal all final_bets/proof before report; no invented odds, no post-race adjustment. The balanced search is deterministic heuristic, not globally optimal. MANDATORY EXECUTION ADDENDUM: At the start of each JRA run read docs/operations/jra_run_completion_addendum_v1.txt and verify its git blob SHA against mandatory_execution_addendum.git_blob_sha. Unless there is a concrete blocker, error, explicit time/tool limit or instruction to stop, CONTINUE WITHOUT EARLY TERMINATION through all requested races, STEP1/STEP2, prereace snapshot/proof, complete HTML/PDF (no page ceiling), validation, GitHub commit/publication and actual public HTTP/file verification. Progress reports, a completed substep, CI green status alone and user absence are never completion or stop criteria. On a real blocker, report the precise failure, completed/remaining stages, changed files and safe next action; never invent missing odds, bypass prereace freezing, modify historical originals, or claim unverified publication. PRE-POST CANONICAL REVISION (user-approved): Read docs/operations/jra_prerace_overwrite_v1.txt and docs/data/jra_prerace_overwrite_policy_v1.json and verify prereace_overwrite_policy SHA pins for every formal run. Before the actual scheduled start of EACH race, a newer duly sealed, timestamped, audited formal prediction MAY replace that race's current public canonical report/PDF/final_bets/registry record. Published pages must show only the newest formal prestart version. Preserve previous immutable prediction JSON, snapshot, proof_commit, previous PDF/HTML as auditable historical artifacts and log the superseded canonical record. Reject all post-start revisions, unproven odds, missing Git proof, unvalidated PDFs and partial HTTP publication. This is a narrow explicit exception to no-overwrite of currently published prestart canonical pointers; historical originals, evaluated past races, reviews, results, STEP1/STEP2 logic and local Shadow remain immutable.

mandatory_execution_addendum.applies_to: all formal JRA runs on v3.11 without modifying prediction algorithm or prior artefacts
